nullRate.note: All five runs of this instrument on this machine today, reported together. The pair required by the card (a1-run1, a1-run2) is NOT a selected subset: it is the first two runs made under the card, and the second was null. No run was discarded or re-rolled to obtain a different verdict.

verdictRationale: The card requires TWO SHA-bound NON-NULL browser measurements before the browser figure can be set against Node's. At 9c0e8ff5 the instrument produced one (357 samples, driveSource case_owned_bedside_approach) and one null (0 samples, driveSource null, waitTimedOut true, no obstacles resolved, no toe bones resolved). Two of five runs today failed the same way, so the null mode is reproducible rather than incidental. A single good run cannot adjudicate a disagreement with a third instrument, and re-running until two happened to succeed would select the runs that suit a verdict. Therefore capture_null: SC-07 stays blocked, A1b is NOT authorised, and the instrument requires repair before the browser-versus-Node question can be answered. Recorded but deliberately NOT ruled on: run 1's non-null data disagrees with Node in a phase-localised way, walking at 0.000652 / -0.000147 m (consistent with Node's above-floor reading) and settling/arrived near 0.0358 / 0.0378 m. That pattern is the hypothesis the repaired instrument should be pointed at; it is not a finding this report is entitled to make on one run.
instrumentRepairLeads: The null runs set driveSource null AND waitTimedOut true AND observedObstacleIds empty AND toeBonesResolved false together, i.e. the scene never reached a state the recorder could read, rather than the recorder failing on a good scene.
Both null runs followed a successful run within minutes on the same machine and SHA, so the cause is not the tree.
The instrument still exits 0 and still writes a plausible 59 KB screenshot on a null capture. An exists:/min-bytes: proof over that PNG would pass on a run that measured nothing.
claimScope: What two headless chromium runs of ui-xr-bedside-approach-capture.ts, at pinned commit 9c0e8ff5, measured about physician toe height against the named floor frame, and whether that pair is sufficient to adjudicate the recorded browser-versus-Node disagreement. It claims nothing about the cause of either instrument's reading.
